item.title: CA high-speed rail construction site catches fire in southeast Fresno
item.description: An investigation is underway after a construction site for the California high-speed rail caught on fire Wednesday morning in southeast Fresno.

item.title: 2 vehicles believed to be used in Stockton mass shooting seized, deputies say
item.description: Two cars believed to be used in the Stockton mass shooting last November have been seized by the San Joaquin County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: 74-year-old woman dies after hit-and-run suspect stabs her after fleeing accident
item.description: One person is in custody after a hit-and-run turned into a fatal assault in Visalia.

item.title: Fresno County sued over new restrictions on sex offenders, claims ordinance is 'unconstitutional'
item.description: The Board of Supervisors is being challenged for its ordinance that is to take effect on Thursday, which seeks to limit the number of sex offenders per single household to a maximum of six.

item.title: Officials warn of new Bluetooth device used to steal gas in Central Valley
item.description: Tulare County agencies are warning people and gas stations about a new device being used to steal fuel after one was discovered in Fresno County during a routine inspection.

item.title: 2 men arrested in Fresno's first homicide of 2026
item.description: Two men have been arrested for the murder of 19-year-old Joe Rodriguez last month. It was Fresno's first homicide for 2026.

item.title: Supreme Court allows new California congressional districts that favor Democrats
item.description: The Supreme Court on Wednesday allowed California to use a new voter-approved congressional map that is favorable to Democrats in this year's elections, rejecting a last-ditch plea from state Republicans and the Trump administration.

item.title: Atwater man arrested on child endangerment charge after infant's death
item.description: An Atwater man has been arrested in connection with an infant's death last month.

item.title: Fresno City College reopens fully on Thursday
item.description: Parts of the campus were closed after a crash on Sunday night damaged a main water line.

item.title: Family and friends remember family taken by tragic house fire
item.description: Members of the Porterville community have left candles and flowers outside the home on Harrison Avenue and Plano Street after a tragic fire left a mother and her two children dead.
